name: Create Bank Transaction
description: Create a new bank transaction [See the documentation](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/accounting/banktransactions#put-banktransactions)

configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: bankAccountCode
configurable_props.label: Bank Account Code
configurable_props.description: The Account Code of the Bank Account of the transaction. If Code is not included then AccountID is required.

configurable_props.name: bankAccountId
configurable_props.label: Bank Account ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the Bank Account transaction. If AccountID is not included then Code is required.

configurable_props.name: contactId
configurable_props.label: Contact ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the contact associated to the bank transaction.

configurable_props.name: contactName
configurable_props.label: Contact Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the contact associated to the bank transaction. If there is no contact matching this name, a new contact is created.

configurable_props.name: lineItems
configurable_props.label: Line Items
configurable_props.description: See [LineItems](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/banktransactions#LineItemsPOST). The LineItems element can contain any number of individual LineItem sub-elements. At least **one** is required to create a bank transaction.

configurable_props.name: isReconciled
configurable_props.label: Is Reconciled
configurable_props.description: Boolean to show if transaction is reconciled. Conversion related apps can set the IsReconciled flag in scenarios when a matching bank statement line is not available. [Learn more](http://help.xero.com/#Q_BankRecNoImport)

configurable_props.name: reference
configurable_props.label: Reference
configurable_props.description: Reference for the transaction. Only supported for SPEND and RECEIVE transactions.

configurable_props.name: currencyCode
configurable_props.label: Currency Code
configurable_props.description: The currency that bank transaction has been raised in (see [Currencies](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/currencies)). Setting currency is only supported on overpayments.

configurable_props.name: currencyRate
configurable_props.label: Currency Rate
configurable_props.description: Exchange rate to base currency when money is spent or received. e.g. 0.7500 Only used for bank transactions in non base currency. If this isn't specified for non base currency accounts then either the user-defined rate (preference) or the [XE.com day rate](http://help.xero.com/#CurrencySettings$Rates) will be used. Setting currency is only supported on overpayments.

configurable_props.name: url
configurable_props.label: URL
configurable_props.description: URL link to a source document - shown as "Go to App Name"

configurable_props.name: lineAmountTypes
configurable_props.label: Line Amount Types
configurable_props.description: Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don't specify this element. See [Line Amount Types](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/types#LineAmountTypes)
